title: A field definition in this board's model
description: A schema over this board's own schema documents, not over a deposit. A deposit never references it and a new schema version does not produce a new copy of it. It carries no $id because this board owns no domain to write one under, and nothing needs to reference it by URI.

field.description: The key as it appears in a deposit's metadata document. Lower case with underscores, as docs/decisions/schema-language.md fixes.

quantity.description: The physical quantity this field holds, named as docs/decisions/conventions.md names it, or the string none where the field is not a physical quantity. The unit follows from the quantity through that record and is not restated here. Nothing refuses a quantity that record does not name.

requirement.description: What the validator does when the field is absent.

requiredWhen.description: The condition under which a conditional field is required, and where that condition is specified. Required when requirement is conditional.

withoutThisField.description: One sentence naming the reanalysis step that fails if the field is absent. Not a description of what the field means. This schema refuses an absent or blank one and cannot judge whether the sentence says what it is supposed to say.

schema.description: The subschema the field's value is validated against, referenced from a version's dataset schema.
